executive_summary: FrinStore pre-final testing combined automated API verification (pytest), manual system testing against the Doc 2 catalogue, targeted UAT with non-developer testers, and a focused regression pass after selected defect fixes. Overall quality is acceptable for academic demonstration with documented limitations on live payments and formal performance testing. Update numeric metrics below after all manual sheets are finalized.

scope_and_objectives.title: Test scope and objectives
scope_and_objectives.text: Validate core marketplace flows (auth, catalog, cart, checkout, orders, admin, RBAC) against docs/Project.json functional requirements; capture defects in Doc 7; confirm fixes via Doc 8.

rows.justification_if_deferred: Low priority UX; tracked for post-submission polish.

lessons_learned.title: Lessons learned
bullets: Automated API tests caught RBAC and checkout regressions quickly.
Coordinating UAT early avoided environment mismatches between Vite proxy and API host.
Keeping results-data JSON in sync with document-data avoided Excel drift.

recommendation.title: Recommendation
recommendation.rationale: Core flows verified by pytest and browser smoke. Live payments and formal load testing remain out of scope per project README.
